assumptions: A point is inside a region when west <= lon <= east and south <= lat <= north (README gives the box, not whether edges count).

Sensor from the file: MODIS rows by the `satellite` column (README says `satellite = A`/`T`; the files say Aqua/Terra, both accepted); VIIRS S-NPP from the SV-C2 download, NOAA-20 from the J1V-C2 download.
Standard = the fire_archive_* member, near-real-time = the fire_nrt_* member of each zip.
Mask cell = (int((lat + 90) / 0.02), int((lon + 180) / 0.02)), as README states since the audit's fixes (the first audit assumed floor(lat / 0.02) and differed by one detection in three months).

As used: NOAA-20 standard against Aqua standard, April 2018 to July 2026; each year predicted from coefficients fitted without it, with the Suomi NPP coefficients and with NOAA-20's own; NOAA-20's own are adopted when their error (to one decimal, as published) is lower; near-real-time months are those where NOAA-20 is near-real-time and complete (README, 'The conversion as it is used').

Mask counts every archive row with type 1, 2 or 3, any sensor, any confidence, anywhere in the files of that raw folder (README: 'built from every file in data/raw/'; it does not say whether low-confidence rows count).
Low confidence: MODIS confidence < 30 (numeric), VIIRS confidence 'l' (README).
Month and day are the UTC acq_date (README does not say; the hotspot CSV keeps acq_date).

Paired training months: February 2012 to July 2026, every month (README: 'every month ... in which both sensors have complete, standard-quality data (174 months)'). A month with zero detections for a sensor still counts as a month with data.
NOAA-20 against S-NPP: April 2018 to July 2026 (README says 100 months; April 2018 to July 2026 is 100 months).

k(m) falls back to the annual coefficient when the Aqua total of that calendar month in the training set is under 30 (README). README does not say what happens when the S-NPP total is 0; treated as fallback too.

Leave-one-year-out: for each calendar year, coefficients are fitted on the other years' paired months and the fallback rule is re-applied inside each fit (README does not say whether the fallback is re-evaluated).
Error = sum |predicted - observed| / sum observed, in percent; bias = (sum predicted - sum observed) / sum observed (README gives the first; bias is inferred from the table heading).

Month to date: D = last acq_date in the downloads minus one day; Aqua NRT and NOAA-20 NRT counted detections for days 1..D of that month; baseline = Aqua standard counted detections for the same days of each year 2002..2025 (README).
